cc:Work.dc:title: Complete service and delivered output
cc:Work.dc:description: Natural EOS; 16 requests/run. Bars: available-run means; points: individual complete runs (ordered within arm). Run-level n is shown per panel; small samples, no CI. Drained time includes final drain and excludes initialization/warmup. Actual output counts differ; times are not equal-work speedups. OLMoE; artificial expert-cache cap of 24 experts/layer. Host chunk gaps are not token-level ITL.
